sentences.text:
1 Reason: Mr. Rohan Singla, Adv.
Mr. Akshay Srivastava, Adv.
UPON being mentioned by counsel the Court made the following O R D E R SLP (Crl.) No.
12450/2024 (Item No. 2) The petitioner (woman) is an accused in Crime No. 39 of 2022 registered under Sections 420, 409, 465, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code.
Her bail application was rejected by the High Court vide impugned order dated 12.08.2024.

The main accused is the husband of the petitioner, and is in jail at present, but we are not getting into the merits of the case of the husband, whose case will be examined on its own merits as far as bail is concerned.

But considering the fact that the petitioner is a woman and has been in jail for the last six months and considering the nature of offences, we are of the opinion that a case of bail is made out for the petitioner and therefore, the prayer for regular bail is allowed.
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail forthwith on the usual terms and conditions to be decided by the concerned Court.

The present Special Leave Petition shall stand disposed of in the above terms along with pending application(s), if any. SLP(Crl) No. 12463/2024 (Item No. 2.1) At the request of learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioner, re-list the matter on 18.11.2024.
In the meantime, as prayed for, Mr. Akshay Srivastava, learned counsel appearing for the complainant, shall file Vakalatnama.

(JAYANT KUMAR ARORA) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR) ASST. REGISTRAR-CUM-PS COURT MASTER Padmajyothi Shreesha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16358970/
